_source: Harish's daily homework (29 and 30-Sep-2026 charts): hammer / double hammer at support, inverted hammer at resistance (day high/low, previous-day high = R1, swing high/low), entry on the follow-through break, exits at the opposite level, 8 EMA or a trailing SL. Edit numbers here, not in code.

pattern._rule: Hammer: lower wick >= wick_body_ratio x body AND >= wick_share of the candle, upper wick <= other_wick_max of the candle. Inverted hammer: the mirror. Double hammer: two candles in a row, both with a lower wick >= double_wick_share of their range, lows within double_low_tolerance points.

levels._rule: Candle extreme within tolerance_points of: today's high/low so far, previous day H/L/C, a 15-min swing high/low (swing_k candles each side, known only after it forms, from the last swing_lookback_bars candles), previous wick_days days' long wicks, OI walls (live), manual levels.

trigger._rule: Follow-through = a later candle trades beyond the pattern candle's high (CE) / low (PE) by buffer_points, within trigger_bars candles, same day.

exit._rule: T1 = nearest opposite level >= 1R (else fallback_r). Trail: once a candle closes trail_after_r in profit, the SL follows each closed candle's low (CE) / high (PE). 8 EMA: exit on a close through it. Everything out by exit_by.

confluence._rule: Shown with every setup, NOT used as a filter until the homework / backtest show which ones matter.

telegram._rule: 15-min signals go out as their own Telegram message (SUPER); 5-min and 3-min together in a second message. Set send_5m / send_3m false to silence them.

history._cost: A setup only gets BEATS RANDOM if its average R minus cost_r (brokerage + slippage) is at least min_net_r. 30-Sep-2026: 15m 0.00 R, 5m -0.03 R, 3m +0.01 R over 5 years - all better than random candles but ~breakeven.

tf_overrides._rule: 15-min uses the base numbers above. 5-min and 3-min candles are smaller, so tolerance, candle size, SL limits and swing windows are smaller and the follow-through window is 3 candles.
